subject: We’d love your feedback on Regroup 💬
body:
Hi Whjalmarson,

I noticed you recently canceled your Regroup subscription, and I just wanted to personally thank you for giving the app a try. Regroup was built to make running sober living homes simpler — helping managers stay organized and residents stay accountable — and your feedback means a lot to us.

If you don’t mind sharing, I’d love to hear why you decided to cancel and what might bring you back. Was something missing, confusing, or buggy? Or is there a feature you wish Regroup had?

Your input helps us improve Regroup for everyone in the recovery community — and we’re already working on updates based on user feedback.

You can just hit “reply” to this email — even a few words would help a lot.

Thank you again for trying Regroup and for the important work you do supporting sober living.

Warm regards,
Marcus Klein
Founder, Regroup
https://regroup-app.com
